This [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] appears to be loosely based on or derived from banoffee pie. It combines bananas and caramel sauce with pre-made dough for convenience. The ingredients are simple, the time it takes to prepare is short, and the dessert is simply delicious!

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* 2 tablespoons melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 refrigerated can of cinnamon rolls
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Caramel|caramel]] sauce
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] vanilla [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]] (optional) 

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C).
# In a small bowl, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] bananas, vanilla, and melted butter until bananas are well coated.
# On a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]], unroll 2 cinnamon rolls, leaving the two triangles attached to form a square. Place ¼ of the banana mixture in the center of each pair of rolls.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 11 to 13 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
# Heat the caramel topping and drizzle over dessert. Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.
